_notes: Fixed/curated boss loot tables, keyed by exact boss creature name (matches data/creatures/creatures.json keys). Read by entities/boss_loot.py's get_fixed_boss_loot(), hooked into combat/combat_engine.py's boss-kill loot roll ahead of the normal generate_boss_loot() procedural fallback - see boss_loot.py's module docstring for why this exists and how it's wired in. Every boss listed here drops ONE random item from its own list (not all of them at once) - matches how a real boss-kill loot roll feels, one drop per kill, just drawn from a small curated pool instead of the fully random generator. All stat/damage numbers computed from the real formulas in entities/loot_generator.py (STAT_BUDGET_BASE_MULT, slot weight_tiers, stat_budget_costs, target_dps) at item_level 13 rarity 'rare' (1.7x), not hand-guessed, so these sit correctly on the game's existing power curve.
